name: USB Wi-Fi for wireless CarPlay (RTL8811AU)
description: Runs the hotspot for wireless CarPlay on a TP-Link Archer T2U Nano (USB ID 2357:011e) in the USB port, for a head unit whose built-in Wi-Fi never comes up. Replaces the Broadcom Wi-Fi driver with a Realtek one; removing the mod restores it. Turn ADB over USB off before plugging in the adapter, and pull the adapter before turning it back on.
